subject: SOC 2 intake: access curation checklist & sampling plan — DocuCare
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@docucare.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: security@docucare.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2: initial ask — SSO/Provisioning samples + sampling cadence

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of our SOC 2 intake we're collecting a small, focused bundle of artifacts to validate access controls scoped to our integration with Redwood. Specifically we need: 

- A role -> owner snapshot (CSV) for the last 90 days
- One SAML assertion sample for a typical login flow (with redactions allowed)
- A SCIM delta/last-sync sample covering a user lifecycle (create -> update -> deactivate)
- A short sampling plan outlining how you'll select accounts for least-privilege verification (sample size + risk criteria)

Can you confirm whether you can provide redacted samples and an estimated delivery date? Our SOC intake window is July 9th, so earlier is helpful.

Also, if there are any template formats you prefer (CSV, JSON) let me know — we can accept whatever's easiest.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Security Engineer — DocuCare Health
From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@docucare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2: initial ask — SSO/Provisioning samples + sampling cadence

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide redacted samples and a concise sampling plan. Plan below and next steps: 

1) Artifacts we will attach: role-owner CSV, one SAML assertion (redacted PII/token fields), representative SCIM delta (JSON)
2) Sampling plan: 30 account sample (10 highest-privilege, 10 random active, 10 recently deprovisioned) with rationale + selection query
3) Delivery ETA: EOD Thu 07/01 (we'll upload to a shared Drive link and provide checksums)

Action items:
- Laura: produce role-owner matrix and sampling spreadsheet
- Jonas: pull SAML assertion sample and SCIM delta; mask identifiers per privacy checklist

If that timeline works, we'll send the Drive link when items are ready. If you need a smaller/larger sample size or different stratification, tell us and we can adjust.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment placeholders: role-owner-matrix.csv (CSV), access-sampling-plan.xlsx (XLSX)

If you can get the bundle by EOD Thursday that would be perfect. I'll flag anything urgent from our side.

Best,
Alice

Hi Alice —

Attached is the initial bundle and sampling plan; uploading to the Drive link below and copying the artifacts here for convenience: 

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Shared/DocuCare/SOC2-intake

Attachments included (redacted):
- role-owner-matrix.csv — mapping of role id, role name, assigned owner, last modified date
- saml-assertion-sample.txt — redacted assertion (NameID/email replaced with <<REDACTED>>)
- scim-delta-20260624.json — example create->update->deactivate sequence (IDs hashed)
- access-sampling-plan.xlsx — selection queries + stratification notes (30 accounts)

Selection method for random active accounts: we used the query in the spreadsheet (SQL-like) that filters by last_login BETWEEN date_range AND status='active' then applies a cryptographic hash-based sample (modulo) seeded by the current deployment id; steps documented in the plan.

If the auditor needs raw logs or additional assertion traces (e.g., timestamped signature info) we can escalate to log retention exports but that will take an extra 48 hours.

Thanks — let us know if you'd prefer a narrower sample or want us to walk the auditor through the selection method in a short call.

Warmly,
Laura Bennett
Senior Product Security Manager
Redwood Inference
